$comment: Every user-visible UI feature and where it stands in each client. web = drover-web (browser and Tauri window), native = drover-desktop (GPUI). Status: done | planned | n/a (n/a needs a reason). Add a line here in the same change that adds the feature to one client; `node design/check-parity.mjs` fails on a missing or invalid status, and --strict lists what one client still lacks.

features.title: Nine themes from tokens.json, chosen in Settings
Terminal colours follow the theme
Sidebar width, top bar and status bar heights come from tokens.json
features.note: web reads --sidebar-width, --topbar-height, --status-height, --pane-radius and --pane-padding from themes.generated.css (phone and tablet layouts keep their own sizes)

features.title: Your own shortcuts in keys.toml
Palette: ranked and fuzzy search, matched letters highlighted
Palette: suggestions for the screen you are on
Shortcut sheet: filter box
Shortcut sheet: your own keys marked
Status bar hints change with the screen
Ctrl+Click file:line in a terminal opens the file
features.note: Native opens it in its own Files editor; a file outside the pane's folder opens in the web UI

features.title: Code editor: tabs, breadcrumb, git marks in the gutter
Send the editor selection to an agent (Alt+S)
Agent terminal beside the editor
features.note: native: the Files panel sits beside the agent terminal; Ctrl+J widens the editor

features.title: Banner and Review pill when an agent is done
Check errors: jump to file:line from failed checks
Review: line comments, hunks reviewed or rejected, send to agent
Review keys: F7 next hunk, A mark reviewed
Chat view: talk to Claude, model picker, permission cards, composer
features.note: native: list (right-click: rename, delete), transcript with tool and permission cards, bold and code inline, Stop, model and mode menus, / and @ suggestions (arrows, Tab, Enter or click), pictures with Ctrl+V. Chats run on this computer only (chat.create has no machine)

features.title: Broadcast dialog: send one message to several agents
features.note: native: palette command "Send to several agents" (keys.toml id: broadcast)

features.title: In-app folder picker for a new space
features.note: native: palette "Open a folder as a new space" and the + menu; machine menu, filter, New folder

features.title: Files: + New file and ↻ Reload buttons, open a folder from the Changed list
Files: middle click closes a tab
Changes: start an agent in a worktree (Agent here)
features.note: native: a menu of the installed agents (web opens its New agent dialog)

features.title: File icons by type (Badges set)
features.note: native draws the Badges set (coloured labels: RS, PY, TSX…)

features.title: New agent dialog: agent, name, folder, arguments, first prompt, task worktree
features.note: native: palette "New agent…" and the + menu; runs on the current space's machine, in a new tab

features.title: Pane stopped by a restart: Resume / Start fresh / Close
features.note: native: a card in the pane's place (the daemon's `stopped` list)

features.title: File icon sets Material and Line, chosen in Settings
features.note: native has only the Badges set

features.title: New agent dialog: machine choice, folder browser, split or background placement, show as Chat
Ctrl+P finds text in terminals' scrollback
features.note: native lists the matching lines under the agents; Enter opens Find there. No live preview pane yet (web shows 24 lines of the terminal)

features.title: Checks strip only where the folder has checks
Machines: New agent here
Chat: Attach a picture button
Ctrl+P: live preview of the selected terminal
Editor: Ctrl+F find in file, Ctrl+G go to line
features.note: native: a box at the top, Enter = next match

features.title: Editor: Ctrl+/ comment, Alt+Up/Down move lines, duplicate and delete lines
features.note: native: Ctrl+Shift+D duplicate, Ctrl+Shift+K delete line

features.title: Editor: find and replace
Editor: auto-close brackets and quotes, matching bracket
Editor: several cursors, code folding
